WITH bucket1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) AS ss_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20
),
bucket2 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) AS ss_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40
),
bucket3 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) AS ss_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60
),
bucket4 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) AS ss_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80
),
bucket5 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        count(*) AS count,
        avg(ss_ext_tax) AS ss_ext_tax,
        avg(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN bucket1.count > 1071 THEN bucket1.ss_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket1.ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    END bucket1,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket2.count > 39161 THEN bucket2.ss_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket2.ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    END bucket2,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket3.count > 29434 THEN bucket3.ss_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket3.ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    END bucket3,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket4.count > 6568 THEN bucket4.ss_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket4.ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    END bucket4,
    CASE
        WHEN bucket5.count > 21216 THEN bucket5.ss_ext_tax
        ELSE bucket5.ss_net_paid_inc_tax
    END bucket5
FROM reason
JOIN bucket1 ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
JOIN bucket2 ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
JOIN bucket3 ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
JOIN bucket4 ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
JOIN bucket5 ON reason.r_reason_sk = 1
WHERE reason.r_reason_sk = 1
